name: Punch close with the install command
looks: A two-word hyphenated headline lands hard-cut beside a small blinking cursor prompt, a subline naming who it is for beneath it. It cuts to the full wordmark with its tagline again, now above a dark terminal pill with a real install command typing on and a small pulsing status dot beside it, three plain badges closing the frame.
build: kinetic-word-run for the hyphenated headline; terminal-type-on for the install command; provenance-glow-stroke for the status dot's pulse; wordmark-assemble's finished-state settle for the repeated lockup.
sound: A hit on the headline, a key tick under the install command, and a soft confirm chime on the final badges.
prompt: Close hard and practical: land a short hyphenated punch line naming who the product is for, then show the real one-line install command typing on beside a pulsing status dot, finishing on the lockup and a short row of plain capability badges.
